meta.title: Nationalism
meta.question: What makes a true Pole?
meta.measure: Average position on the nation, from 0 (cosmopolitan) to 10 (nationalist)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on what makes a true Pole, national chauvinism and cultural homogeneity, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: The world would be a better place if people from other countries were more like the Poles (agree-disagree)
Generally speaking, Poland is a better country than most other countries (agree-disagree)
Important for being truly Polish: being born in Poland
Important for being truly Polish: being a Catholic
Nationalism is harmful to the development of our country
Our people are not perfect, but our culture is superior to others
Our way of life needs to be protected against foreign influence
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2002, 2007, 2009 (3 surveys; 2012-2016 versions not asked in Poland).

items.wording: It is better for a country if almost everyone shares the same customs and traditions (agree-disagree)
Is Polish descent (at least one Polish parent) necessary for someone to count as a Pole?
items.notes: CBOS November 2003 (1 survey). 2005's version is a pick-two list and fails the label check.

items.wording: Important for being truly Polish: Polish ancestry
How important as a requirement for citizenship is having ancestors from the country?
How important as a requirement for citizenship is being born on the country's soil?
Important for being truly Polish: being born in Poland
Important for being Polish: being a Christian
Important for being truly Polish: Polish parents or ancestors
Important for being truly Polish: Polish customs and traditions
How important for being truly Polish is having Polish ancestry?
How important for being truly Polish is having been born in Poland?
How important for being truly Polish is having been born in Poland?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2016, 2023 (2 surveys; 2024's version was not asked in Poland).

items.wording: How important for being truly Polish is being Catholic?
How important for being truly Polish is sharing Polish customs and traditions?
Poles should not form relationships with people of other nationalities

Do you consider yourself a nationalist?
Polish authorities must be supported internationally even when we disagree with them
A true Pole should be a Catholic
items.notes: CBOS October 2016 (1 survey; two copies of the variable, the first is used).

items.wording: How important for being truly Polish is sharing Polish culture?
Talk of a threat to (loss of) national identity is usually exaggerated
items.notes: POLPAN 2013, 2018 (2 waves); the wording differs slightly between them.

items.wording: Poles should put more effort into strengthening their national pride
items.notes: POLPAN 2013, 2018 (2 waves). 2013 asks it twice; the first is used.

items.wording: Our society needs protection from international influences rather than further opening to them
items.notes: NCN Opus online panel wave 3, April 2024 (1 survey).

items.notes: FNW SWPS online survey December 2025 (1 survey).
